jobs.occupation: PhD position (m/f/x): Data analysis for exotic hadrons at hadronic thresholds (Physiker/in)
jobs.description:
In order to fill a fixed-term position in part-time (26.2878 hours/week = 66%) at the earliest possible date, we are looking for 1

PhD position (m/f/x): Data analysis for exotic hadrons at hadronic thresholds

The work of the chair of experimental physics 1 focuses on basic research: One of the most essential elements of todays education and research is to gain a better understanding of the structure of matter and the fundamental principles of nature. In this process the basic research of physics plays an important role as it provides a base for technical innovations and development. Hadron Physics deals with strong interacting particles consisting of quarks and gluons. Among those hadrons also rank the building blocks of the atomic nucleus, the proton and the neutron. There are many other hadrons that can only be created via collisions of high energetic particles in big particle accelerators. The created hadrons are detected by modern and complex detectors to examine their composition and interactions.

The position is embedded in two research programs. DEMOS ("Democratizing Models") is an ErUM research initiative developing a federated, interoperable standard for describing, sharing and re-evaluating physics models across particle, hadron, nuclear, neutrino and astroparticle physics. Hadronic coupled-channel amplitudes are one of its flagship applications: they are analytically intricate and rarely reproducible from the publication alone, which makes them an ideal test case for the new standard. HADRON 2030 is an intercollaborative research network dedicated to studies of hadron physics. Within the ExHAT (Exploration of Heavy Hadrons at Thresholds) project, we will explore heavy hadrons at thresholds using spectroscopy methods with LHCb data and inclusive production studies with ALICE. The flagship case is the doubly charmed tetraquark Tcc(3875)+, which lies a fraction of an MeV below the D0 D*+ threshold. Line shape, pole position, three-body DD-pi dynamics and isospin breaking have to be disentangled in a joint effort of theory and experiment.

Scope: part-time
Duration: fixed-term, 3 years
Start: at the earliest possible date
Apply by:  2026-10-06

Your tasks:

- Application of advanced methods of data selection, efficiency and resolution
studies within LHCb data analysis.
- Construction, fitting and analytic continuation of coupled-channel scattering
amplitudes.
- Decipherment and serialization of the complex amplitudes in the DEMOS /
amplitude-serialization format.
- Collaboration within the DEMOS / HADRON 2030 networks.
Exchange with the experimental collaborations
[LHCb, BESIII, Belle II, GlueX, ...] and with EFT/lattice QCD groups.

Your profile:

- Master's degree (or equivalent) in physics, completed by the starting date.
- Background in experimental particle physics or hadron physics, and familiarity

with quantum field theory and scattering theory.

- Good scientific programming skills (Julia, Python or C++) and experience with

version control and reproducible workflows.

- Very good command of written and spoken English.
- Interest in working at the interface between theory and experiment and in open,

reusable research software.

One full-time Postdoc position (m,f,x) for three years on Hyperproperties for Partially Observable Systems under Uncertainty (TV-L E14, 39.83 hours per week)

The chair of Artificial Intelligence and Formal Methods at the Ruhr-University Bochum in Germany (headed by Prof. Dr. Nils Jansen) conducts broad foundational and application-driven research on decision-making under uncertainty.

We are seeking a highly motivated postdoctoral researcher to develop formal methods for specifying and verifying hyperproperties of partially observable systems operating under uncertainty. The project combines techniques from formal verification, probabilistic model checking, quantitative reasoning, and strategy synthesis to analyze systems whose behavior depends on incomplete information and stochastic environments. The research is motivated by the growing need to ensure security and safety in autonomous, cyber-physical, and AI-enabled systems. Hyperproperties provide a powerful framework for expressing requirements such as information-flow security, privacy, and consistency across multiple executions, while partial observability and uncertainty reflect the challenges of real-world decision-making systems. The project aims to advance verification and synthesis techniques for trustworthy systems with rigorous correctness guarantees.

Scope: full-time
Duration: fixed-term, 3 years

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Researcher in Computer Vision and Multimodal AI for the Early Detection of Parkinson’s (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description:
The University Hospital Bonn (UKB) is one of Germany’s leading university hospitals, combining top-level performance in medicine and research with excellence in teaching. Each year, more than half a million patients receive inpatient and outpatient care at the UKB. Around 3,500 students study medicine and dentistry here, and over 600 people are trained annually in healthcare professions. With approximately 9,900 employees, the UKB is the third-largest employer in the Bonn/Rhein-Sieg region. In the Focus hospital ranking, the UKB ranks first among university hospitals in North Rhine-Westphalia and second nationwide in terms of case mix index (case severity). In 2024, the UKB raised nearly €100 million in third-party funding for research, development, and teaching. The F.A.Z. Institute has named the UKB “Germany’s Training Champion” and “Germany’s Most Attractive Employer” for the fourth consecutive year.

The following full-time (38.5 hours/week) position is to be filled as soon as possible at the Center of Neurology of the University Hospital Bonn:

Postdoctoral Researcher in Computer Vision and Multimodal AI for the Early Detection of Parkinson’s Disease (m/w/d)

The position is fixed-term until 30 September 2028 due to the duration of the research project.

Parkinson’s disease is usually diagnosed only after substantial neurodegeneration has already occurred. Subtle changes in movement, facial expression and speech may emerge years earlier, but current clinical assessments are not designed to detect and quantify them at scale. We believe that computer vision and multimodal AI can help close this gap - and that meaningful progress requires researchers who want to apply cutting-edge methods to a major clinical challenge.

Our goal is to develop objective and scalable digital tools for the early detection and monitoring of Parkinson’s disease. We combine video-based analysis of gait, balance, facial expression and limb movements with speech, touchscreen and wearable sensor data. A particular focus is on individuals with isolated REM sleep behavior disorder, who are at high risk of developing Parkinson’s disease or related neurodegenerative disorders.

The group of Prof. Dr. Michael Sommerauer at the Center of Neurology at the University Hospital Bonn and the German Center for Neurodegenerative Diseases (DZNE) is seeking a highly motivated postdoctoral researcher to join our interdisciplinary team.

The successful candidate will take a leading role in the development of the computer vision components of bradyMX, our multimodal digital motor assessment platform. The position is embedded in the ERC-funded Re-START PD research program and offers the opportunity to work with unique, deeply phenotyped clinical cohorts and longitudinal datasets. Rather than developing methods in isolation, you will work closely with clinicians and neuroscientists to translate methodological advances into tools that may improve patient stratification, clinical trials and, ultimately, the way Parkinson’s disease is detected.

Please submit your application as a single PDF, including: 

• a cover letter describing your scientific interests and motivation for joining the group 

• a curriculum vitae including a publication list 

• contact details for at least two referees

Your responsibilities:

- Lead the development of computer vision methods for quantifying subtle motor abnormalities from clinical video recordings
- Develop robust pipelines for human pose estimation, facial and body landmark detection, movement segmentation, tracking, feature extraction and automated quality control
- Design and evaluate machine-learning and deep-learning models for the analysis of gait, balance, facial expression and upper- and lower-limb movements
- Investigate temporal modelling, representation learning and interpretable movement features for the detection and monitoring of early motor dysfunction
- Integrate video-derived features with complementary digital modalities such as speech, touchscreen tasks, inertial sensors and clinical assessments
- Evaluate model robustness and generalizability across participants, recording conditions, devices and international study sites
- Work closely with the clinical research team on study design, data collection, annotation strategies and the interpretation of model outputs
- Prepare scientific manuscripts, present results at international conferences and contribute to grant applications
- Support the supervision of doctoral, Master’s and medical students

Your profile:

- - A doctoral degree in computer vision, machine learning, computer science, biomedical engineering, medical informatics or a closely related discipline
- Strong experience in machine learning and deep learning for image, video or human movement analysis
- Excellent programming skills in Python and practical experience with frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow or JAX
- Experience in one or more of the following areas: human pose estimation, motion tracking, action recognition, temporal modelling, self-supervised learning, multimodal learning or domain adaptation
- A sound understanding of experimental design, quantitative model evaluation and reproducible research practices
- Experience with version control and collaborative software development; knowledge of containerized workflows and high-performance computing is an advantage
- Interest in translating methodological advances into clinically meaningful applications; previous experience in Parkinson’s disease or medical research is welcome but not required
- A high degree of scientific curiosity, independence and commitment to rigorous research
- Strong communication skills and enthusiasm for working in an interdisciplinary and international environment

What we offer:

jobs.description:
The group of Prof. Dr. Eva Nowack, Institute of Microbial Cell Biology at Heinrich Heine University Düsseldorf is looking for
Postdoc (m/f/d) in Endosymbiosis Research
Job-ID: J000000668
Working hours: Full time
Location: Düsseldorf
Start date: 01.01.2027
Limited until: 31.12.2028
Apply till: 21.10.2026
Payment group: EGr. 13 TV-L
Organization: MathematischNaturwissenschaftliche Fakultät
Job Category: science / research / teach To support our ongoing research, we are seeking a highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to join our team. Our group is an enthusiastic and collaborative team of cell and evolutionary biologists investigating the evolutionary transition from bacterial endosymbionts to eukaryotic organelles. We seek to understand, at the mechanistic level, how protists interact with permanent bacterial endosymbionts and how these associations evolve toward organellogenesis. To address these questions, we combine state-of-the-art omics approaches with detailed molecular biological and protein biochemical experimentation. As model systems, we have established the photosynthetic amoeba Paulinella chromatophora and the symbiont-harboring trypanosomatid Angomonas deanei and related species in the laboratory. Our work has provided exciting insights into organellogenesis and enabled us to develop novel tools for dissecting the molecular and cellular biology of host-symbiont interactions (see e.g., Morales et al. (2023) Curr Biol. doi: 10.1016/j.cub.2022.11.020.; Sørensen et al. (2024) FEBS J. doi: 10.1111/febs.17356; Maurya et al. (2025) Science Adv. doi: 10.1126/sciadv.adp8518; Klimenko et al. (2025) Plant Phys. doi: 10.1093/plphys/kiaf504; Hammond et al. (2026) Nat Commun. doi: 10.1038/s41467-026-70084-0.). The successful candidate will contribute to a current project at the heart of our research program, with the opportunity to shape the project in part according to their scientific interests, expertise, and strengths. The position will also involve a limited amount of undergraduate teaching in German [4 contact hours (Semesterwochenstunden) per week], providing an opportunity to contribute to the training of the next generation of biologists.
A PhD in biology, biochemistry or a related area
An excellent academic track record
Research experience in microbiology or cell biology, genetic engineering, and advanced microscopy techniques
Experience with organelle biology, symbioses or protistology is a plus
A strong motivation in experimental work, literature search and scientific writing

Fluency (oral and written) in English and German
Proactive character, creativity, communication and presentation skills, excellent organization and analytical skills
The position is initially limited for a period of 2 years with the possibility of extension. It is a qualification position in the sense of the Act of Academic Fixed-Term Contract (Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz - WissZeitVG), which is to promote the scientific qualification of the employee. jobs.occupation: (Senior) Brand Manager for Animal Health Global Brands (m/w/d) (Content-Marketing-Manager/in)
jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
Tasks & responsibilities

- In this role, you will support strategic marketing initiatives for individual brand(s), including long-term category strategy development for a portfolio to support success in strategic markets based on deep customer understanding.
- With a strong strategic focus, you will drive the Brand Plan and strategy deployment, including strategic pricing guidance, category focus, geo expansion, and clear prioritization.
- Working closely with the Franchise Head/Senior Brand Manager, you will support the development of marketing campaigns for brand(s) across veterinary and/or non-veterinary channels, resulting in channel-specific portfolio campaigns.
- In close collaboration with GCB, you will support the Franchise Head in governing brand strategy execution, including KPI definition and brand equity tracking in strategic countries.
- As part of the portfolio team, you will contribute to defining life cycle management for current brands and future projects, including review of pipeline and BD&L initiatives.
- To enable successful execution, you will help define key strategic initiatives to achieve product targets, including must-win priorities.
- Additionally, you will drive digital transformation in marketing and promotion for brands and collaborate across the franchise and the wider pet business.
- Furthermore, you will support the development of brand guidance and brand positioning, ensuring that new and existing brands fit coherently into the portfolio and managing related changes (e.g. packaging, positioning, LCM).

Additional tasks for Senior Brand Manager role:

- Additionally, you will tailor brand strategies and strategic initiatives for (R)OPU archetypes, with a strong focus on strategic countries.
- Furthermore, you will define life cycle management for current brands and future projects, including review of pipeline and BD&L opportunities within the category.
- At the same time, you will lead the development of marketing campaigns across all relevant channels, with a strong emphasis on digital transformation.
- Beyond this, you will develop brand guidance and positioning, ensuring alignment of new and existing brands within the portfolio and steering changes such as packaging, positioning, and LCM.
- Finally, you will support the Franchise Head in overall franchise strategy development while being accountable for the brand/project budget and adherence.

Requirements

- University degree required; Master degree (e.g., MBA, MSc) highly desirable
- Highly specialized knowledge and work experience in different parts of business, including Marketing roles in local & regional roles. Sales role experience is desirable.
- Requires strong understanding of business operations across regional/local levels and different geographic specificities, portfolio specifics.
- Strong strategic marketing and analytical capabilities
- Fluent command of English

Additional requirements for Senior Brand Manager role:

- Long-term brand management experience; exposure to local and operational strategic marketing
- Proven project leadership and project management experience; budget and resource oversight
- Deep understanding of regional and local business operations, geographic specificities, and portfolio dynamics
- Strong stakeholder management skills; ability to influence and gain buy-in in a cross-cultural, matrixed environment
- Excellent strategic marketing mindset combined with strong analytical capabilities
- High agility; ability to evolve strategic and tactical approaches based on research data and industry trends

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

jobs.occupation: (Senior) HEOR Manager (m/w/d) (Produktmanager/in)
jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
OUR COMPANY

At Boehringer Ingelheim we develop breakthrough therapies and innovative healthcare solutions in areas of unmet medical need for both humans and animals. As a family owned company, we focus on long-term performance. We believe that, if we have talented and ambitious people who are passionate about innovation, there is no limit to what we can achieve; after all, we started with just 28 people. Now, we are powered by 50,000 employees globally who nurture a diverse, collaborative and inclusive culture.

The Position
Are you passionate about innovation, finding cutting-edge solutions and creating value where it matters, around the globe? At the BI global Inflammation team, we strive to deliver innovative Therapeutic and patient centric solutions by putting the patient in the center of everything we do. We foster innovative thinking as well as an agile and collaborative way of working to advance our novel programs and capabilities in Therapeutic Area Inflammation.
The Global TA Inflammation, (Senior) HEOR  Manager, brings technical expertise, driving Outcomes Research (HEOR) and Patient Related Outcomes fostering our patient centric drive. His/she will support the TA Market Access Head by providing oversight, direction, and functional support on HEOR & PRO & Access projects. He/she will be working closely with Value and Evidence Networks within our Global Business Unit and with external stakeholders.
Tasks & responsibilities

- In your new role, you develop and execute on health economics outcomes research (HEOR) & PRO strategies, demonstrating the medical and economic payer-relevant needs to optimize value of BI products.
- In this function, you generate evidence that secures optimal market access, successful HTA assessments, optimal pricing, reimbursement and formulary listing for BI products on a global scale.
- Additionally, you ensure insights to further inform development of the Target Product Profile (TPP), clinical development plan of our pipeline compounds.
- In consideration of regulatory body request and trial development, pre and post launch you will ensure relevant and new patient-reported outcome (PRO) measurement strategies to ensure that the patient perspective is captured in our clinical trial program and interact with regulatory authorities, closely collaborating with other functions.
- Besides, you ensure efficient and timely development of key HEOR deliverables (i.e. payer value stories, payer engagement tools, GVDs, economic models, retrospective database analyses, indirect comparisons, real world evidence data) for assigned BI products.
- Finally, yet importantly, you develop and maintain relevant partnerships with payers, academic research institutions, contract research organizations and other HEOR thought leaders in order to optimize the impact of HEOR & PRO research.

Additional responsibilities as Senior Manager:

- You will define long-term global development strategies for the assets, in close collaboration with the global Marketing and global Medical counterparts, to ensure optimal patient access.
- In addition, you will draft long-term publication strategies, considering the long-term global market development.

Requirements

- Graduate degree, preferably PhD in health economics, Medicine (MD), public health, pharmacy, focusing on Health Technology Assessment, PRO, Pharmacy, Medicine, Public Health
- Several years of pharma industry experience, with positions in areas of relevance for HEOR, PRO consulting or payer authorities
- Multiple years of direct experience undertaking Health Technology Assessments (HTA) & PRO including Evaluations for Regulatory and health authority interventions of pharmaceutical products
- Conducting or being part of a team working on non-interventional studies and RWE programs
- Demonstrated experience of successful regulatory, reimbursement negotiations for launching new products in key markets
- Proven track record of delivering value demonstration materials that resulted in timely patient access and adoption
- Proven ability in appraising clinical evidence (both RCTs and operational evidence)
- Profound knowledge and expertise to formulating COA strategies including validation methods, administration of measures and statistical analyses of COA data
- Excellent communication and influencing skill both in internal and external context

Additional requirements as Senior HEOR Manager:

- Long-term pharma industry experience, with positions in the areas of health economics, pricing & reimbursement, consulting, or payer authorities
- Several years of exposure to international business on a day-to-day basis
- Strong track record in value generation, demonstration and/or communication
- Highly experienced in conducting health economics/outcomes research across multiple specialty disciplines (e.g. patient reported outcomes, health economic modelling, real world data generation)

For employees with a current contract of limited duration, legal / labor agreement requirements for contract extension will be considered.

jobs.occupation: Senior HR Specialist - Apprenticeship & Vocational Training (m/f/d) (Ausbildungsberater/in)
jobs.description:
About us The European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH
is a joint venture between TSMC, Bosch, Infineon, and NXP. For the
first time, TSMC, the global technology leader, is establishing a
semiconductor fabrication plant in the heart of Europe, offering
leading-edge manufacturing technologies for next-generation
semiconductor products. ESMC represents a shared commitment to
strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. For our future fab
in Dresden, we are looking for a highly motivated and dedicated:
Senior HR Specialist - Apprenticeship & Vocational Training (m/f/d)
Are you ready to strategically and pedagogically lead the end-to-end
apprentice journey for Europe's newest, most advanced semiconductor
facility? As a Senior HR Specialist - Apprenticeship & Vocational
Training (m/f/d) at ESMC in Dresden, you will move beyond standard
administration to drive collaborative success across all core phases
of our technical vocational education. You will be the architect of
our future talent pipeline— managing employer branding at schools,
coordinating dual-training plans, mentoring Gen-Z apprentices, and
ensuring legal compliance. Fitting into our fast-paced greenfield
environment, this role offers a unique opportunity to shape the next
generation of microtechnology and industrial specialists from the
ground up! Tasks Talent Attraction & Recruitment: Design and execute
targeted school marketing strategies, represent ESMC at career fairs,
manage the applicant pipeline, conduct interviews, and issue
apprenticeship contracts. Onboarding & Pastoral Care: Serve as the
primary point of contact and dedicated mentor for future apprentices,
coordinating orientation phases and providing continuous coaching.
Training Curriculum Coordination: Design dual-training plans, manage
internal rotations across manufacturing departments, and coordinate
closely with local vocational schools (Berufsschulen).
Train-the-Trainer Support: Provide ongoing pedagogical and structured
guidance to our operational Fab trainers on the manufacturing floor.
Legal Compliance: Ensure full operational compliance with the German
Vocational Training Act (BBiG), the Youth Employment Protection Act
(JArbSchG), and other relevant educational laws. Key Stakeholder
Management: Build and maintain excellent collaborative relationships
with the local Works Council (Betriebsrat/JAV), vocational schools,
and local chambers (IHK). Graduation & Placement: Coordinate final
exam preparations, align with department managers to map out
post-graduation career pathways, and handle transition contract
processes. Profile Must-Have: Certifications: Holder of the AdA-Schein
(AEVO / Ausbildereignungsprüfung)—the mandatory qualification to
train apprentices in Germany. Education: Academic degree (B.Sc./M.Sc.)
or certified technical expert background (Staatlich geprüfter
Techniker) with a verified trainer/tester license. Experience: 5+
years of professional experience managing vocational training programs
within a technical, manufacturing, or industrial environment (e.g.,
semiconductor, automotive, automation, or chemical industries).
Regulatory & Institutional Knowledge: Strong, practical experience
working successfully with the IHK and a deep understanding of German
legal frameworks (BBiG, JArbSchG, and BetrVG). Languages: Fluent
German (C1/C2) is mandatory for official communications with
authorities, schools, and parents. Strong English skills (B2/C1) are
required for internal collaboration in our international corporate
environment. Pedagogical Drive: Exceptional communication skills with
the ability to motivate, resolve conflicts, and guide Gen-Z young
adults through their personal and professional development.
Nice-to-Have: Familiarity with cleanroom environments, semiconductor
fab safety regulations, and the technical demands of Microtechnology
(Mikrotechnologe/In). Experience setting up apprenticeship structures
in a fast-growing, ramp-up corporate environment. We offer Security &
Perspective: A permanent employment contract and career advancement
opportunities in one of Europe's leading semiconductors fabs. Company
Pension Plan & Financial Benefits: We support your financial
well-being with our robust company pension plan. As an ESMC employee,
you also benefit directly from TSMC’s performance through an
exclusive Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP). Relocation Support for
Dresden: Moving for us? We’ll provide you with all the support you
will need for your relocation and your start in Dresden. Training &
Development: At the TSMC Newcomer Training Center, gain a deeper
understanding of the processes involved in operating complex
semiconductor equipment through unique hands-on training, while you
continuously expand your knowledge. Health & Well-Being: An annual
budget for your health and well-being (e.g., for sports classes,
massages, or relaxation) helps you stay fit. Meals & Transportation:
Enjoy a daily meal allowance as well as a subsidized public
transportation (e.g., for the Deutschlandticket). Additional contact
details Please apply with your English resume.

testing standards, and verify the quality of incoming materials and
facility chemical systems. Collaborating closely with our advanced
teams in Taiwan and leading a small group of local technicians, you
will directly safeguard the production quality of Europe's newest
premier semiconductor fab! Tasks Lab Infrastructure Setup: Design,

Procedures (SOPs) for the laboratory environment. Team Leadership:

analytical techniques such as ICP-MS, GC-MS, PTR-MS, or Ion
Chromatography (IC). Analytical Skillset: Experience in standard
sample preparation, calibration curves, statistical process control
(SPC) data interpretation, and analytical instrument troubleshooting.

to safety and quality. Languages: Fluency in English (written and
spoken) is required. Nice-to-Have: Prior experience in a semiconductor
manufacturing environment or cleanroom chemical lab management.
Knowledge of European chemical regulations (such as REACH) and safety
standards. Basic programming skills (e.g., Python, R, or SQL) for
analytical data processing. Basic communication skills in German
and/or Mandarin. We offer Security & Perspective: A permanent
employment contract and career advancement opportunities in one of
Europe's leading semiconductors fabs. Company Pension Plan & Financial
Benefits: We support your financial well-being with our robust company
